subject: How do I get the color scale from Plot recombination fractions?

messages.author: e414e28cd4417c50
messages.subject: How do I get the color scale from Plot recombination fractions?
parts:
Hello. 
How do I get the color scale from Plot recombination fractions?
When I use:
>plotRF(data, what = c("both"))

I get this kind of plot:



How can I get a scale that shows the LOD and RF values that the colors represent? As it can be  seen in the next plot (that I have got from: Velmurugan, J., Milbourne, D., Connolly, V., Heslop-Harrison, J. S., Anhalt, U. C. M., Lynch, M. B., & Barth, S. (2018). An immortalized genetic mapping population for perennial ryegrass: A resource for phenotyping and complex trait mapping. Frontiers in Plant Science, 9(May), 1–13. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpls.2018.00717)


Than you very much!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: How do I get the color scale from Plot recombination fractions?
parts:
We don't have an option for the color scale for the plot of recombination fractions; sorry. We'd viewed it as something of only qualitative interest, for data diagnostics.

The code is here:
    https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/R/est.rf.R#L159-L281

We threshold the LOD values at zmax (an input argument, with default 12) and use image() to make the heat map. The color scale goes from 0 to 12. The recombination fractions get transformed by
-4*(log2(rf +1)/12*zmax

karl

messages.subject: Re: How do I get the color scale from Plot recombination fractions?

I thought about this some more. We can create the color scale "by hand" with layout() and image().

Example code here: https://gist.github.com/kbroman/23a81082010dbea2788c72c6d16121fd

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: How do I get the color scale from Plot recombination fractions?
parts:
Also note I stated the rec frac transformation wrong. It's -4 ( log2(rf) + 1 ) / 12 * zmax

So  constant * (log2(rf) + 1) not  constant * log2(rf + 1).

karl
